title: Radio: John Lennon on KHJ-AM | 1974
content:
John Lennon made an appearance on Los Angeles radio station KHJ-AM on 20 September 1974.

He was standing in for morning presenter Charlie Van Dyke, as part of a ‘Superstar Week’ of guest DJs. Others taking part during the week included Cher, Alice Cooper, Elton John, and Cheech and Chong.

Lennon played requests, plugged his forthcoming album Walls And Bridges, and chatted to listeners on air.

In the evening Lennon and Pang attended the birthday party of Ricci Martin, son of Dean Martin. Also attending were David Bowie, Elizabeth Taylor, and Ringo Starr and his partner Nancy Lee Andrews. It was there that Lennon met Bowie for the first time.
